description: Set the daily budget (in account currency, e.g. USD) on a campaign or ad squad. Refused above the absolute limit (SNAP_MAX_DAILY_BUDGET), above the allowed increase per step and per 24 hours (default +100%), and below the minimum. Previews unless confirm=true. For several items at once pass adsquad_ids instead of the single id: Change the daily budget of up to 20 ad squads at once: mode 'set' (same value for all) or 'scale' (multiply each, e.g. 0.5 = half). Every item keeps the single-item guards (absolute limit, max +100% per step and per 24 hours, minimum budget). Previews unless confirm=true. Use to change one campaign's or ad squad's daily budget. For several ad squads at once pass adsquad_ids (and mode set or scale) instead of id. Not for lifetime budgets.

adsquad_ids.description: Ad squad ids. Get them from snap_list_adsquads.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

daily_budget.description: Daily budget in account currency, for example 25. Limited by SNAP_MAX_DAILY_BUDGET.

entity.description: What to act on: campaign, adsquad or ad (ad squads are Snapchat's ad sets).

id.description: Id of the item named by entity. Get it from snap_list_campaigns, snap_list_adsquads or snap_list_ads.

mode.description: How to apply the value (see the tool description for the choices).

value.description: The number to apply: the new amount, or the multiplier when mode is scale.

name: snap_set_daily_budget
